youtube.title: They Left Their Own Heads Behind | The 1962 Alcatraz Escape
youtube.description:
On the night of June 11, 1962, Frank Morris and brothers John and Clarence Anglin escaped Alcatraz, leaving dummy heads of soap, toilet paper and real hair in their bunks. The FBI's own memos record a paddle found floating between Alcatraz and Angel Island and no trace of the men on land or in the water. The FBI closed its case in 1979; the U.S. Marshals Service still treats it as open.

📂 Case File #011: The Alcatraz Escape

Sources: FBI Records Vault, 'Alcatraz Escape' file (memo of 12–13 June 1962): https://vault.fbi.gov/Alcatraz%20Escape
